## Update a coupon collection by id

<a id="opIdupdateCouponCollection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/couponCollections/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "defaultCoupon": "10 OFF",
    "expirationDate": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "remainingCouponsAlert": 5,
    "remainingDaysAlert": 5
  }'
```

`PATCH /couponCollections/{id}`

Update an existing coupon collection by its UUID. You can modify the default coupon value, set or remove the expiration date (pass `null` to remove), and configure or disable alert thresholds for remaining coupons or remaining days. Only the fields included in the request body are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "defaultCoupon": "10 OFF",
  "expirationDate": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "remainingCouponsAlert": 5,
  "remainingDaysAlert": 5
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-coupon-collection-by-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuidv4)|true|Id of the collection to update|
|body|body|object|false|Values to update the coupon collection|
|» defaultCoupon|body|string|false|A default coupon to be used in case there are no coupons left|
|» expirationDate|body|string(date-time)|false|Specify an expiration date for the coupon collection in RFC3339 format. Use null to remove the expiration date.|
|» remainingCouponsAlert|body|integer|false|Send a notification alert (email) when the remaining coupons count is equal or fall bellow this number. Use null to disable alerts.|
|» remainingDaysAlert|body|integer|false|Send a notification alert (email) when the remaining days until the expiration date are equal or fall bellow this number. Use null to disable alerts.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "defaultCoupon": "10 OFF",
  "id": "23befbae-1505-47a8-bd27-e30ef739f32c",
```

<a id="opIdcreateCoupons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/coupons \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "collectionId": "23befbae-1505-47a8-bd27-e30ef739f32c",
    "coupons": [
      "Uf12AF"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /coupons`

Add coupons to an existing coupon collection. The `coupons` array must contain between 1 and 10,000 unique coupon code strings, all associated with the specified `collectionId`. Coupon creation is processed asynchronously and a `204` status is returned immediately upon acceptance. Returns a `404` error if the specified coupon collection does not exist.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "collectionId": "23befbae-1505-47a8-bd27-e30ef739f32c",
  "coupons": [
    "Uf12AF"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-coupons-for-a-coupon-collection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Values to create coupons|
|» collectionId|body|string(uuidv4)|true|The id of the coupon collection for which the coupons will be created|
|» coupons|body|[string]|true|none|

```json
}
```

<h1 id="brevo-api-payments">Payments</h1>

## Create a payment request

<a id="opIdcreatePaymentRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/payments/requests \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "cart": {
      "currency": "EUR",
      "specificAmount": 1200
    },
    "configuration": {
      "customSuccessUrl": "https://my-company.com/payment-success"
    },
    "contactId": 43,
    "description": "Shipping Cost for sending bottles to NYC",
    "notification": {
      "channel": "email",
      "text": "Please pay for your yoga class."
    },
    "reference": "Invoice #INV0001"
  }'
```

`POST /payments/requests`

Create a new payment request for a Brevo contact. The request requires a reference (displayed on the payment page), a contact ID, and a cart with currency and amount in cents. You can optionally configure a custom success redirect URL and enable email notifications with reminders. Returns the payment request ID and its public payment URL. A `403` error is returned if Brevo Payments is not activated or the account is not validated.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cart": {
    "currency": "EUR",
    "specificAmount": 1200
  },
  "configuration": {
    "customSuccessUrl": "https://my-company.com/payment-success"
  },
  "contactId": 43,
  "description": "Shipping Cost for sending bottles to NYC",
  "notification": {
    "channel": "email",
    "text": "Please pay for your yoga class."
  },
  "reference": "Invoice #INV0001"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-payment-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Create a payment request<br>|
|» cart|body|[cart](#schemacart)|true|Specify the payment currency and amount.<br>|
|» configuration|body|[configuration](#schemaconfiguration)|false|Optional. Redirect contact to a custom success page once payment is successful. If empty the default Brevo page will be displayed once a payment is validated<br>|
|» contactId|body|integer(int64)|true|Brevo ID of the contact requested to pay.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of payment request.<br>|
|» notification|body|[notification](#schemanotification)|false|Optional. Use this object if you want to let Brevo send an email to the contact, with the payment request URL. If empty, no notifications (message and reminders) will be sent.<br>|
|» reference|body|string|true|Reference of the payment request, it will appear on the payment page.<br>|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "6d4ec0b2b48ef803df4103ve",
  "url": "https://pay.brevo.com/payment/6d4ec0b2b48ef803df4103ve"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

|400|Bad Request|bad request|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|bad request|Inline|

## Get payment request details

<a id="opIdgetPaymentRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/payments/requests/050db7b0-9bb7-4c1e-9c68-5a8dace8c1dc \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /payments/requests/{id}`

Retrieve the details of a specific payment request by its ID. The response includes the reference, status (created, sent, reminderSent, or paid), cart details, notification configuration, contact ID, and the number of reminders sent. Returns a `404` error if no payment request matches the provided ID.

```json
  "contactId": 43,
  "notification": {

  "numberOfRemindersSent": 5,
  "reference": "Invoice #INV0001\n",
```

<a id="opIddeletePaymentRequest"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/payments/requests/9ae7d68a-565c-4695-9381-d8fb3e3a14cc \
```

`DELETE /payments/requests/{id}`

<h1 id="brevo-api-event">Event</h1>

## Get events

<a id="opIdgetEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/events \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /events`

Retrieve a list of events filtered by various criteria.

<h3 id="get-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contact_id|query|[integer(int64)]|false|Filter by contact ID (repeatable)|
|event_name|query|[string]|false|Filter by event name (repeatable)|
|object_type|query|[string]|false|Filter by object type (repeatable)|
|startDate|query|string|false|Mandatory if endDate is used. Start of date range (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339). Defaults to 6 months ago when omitted alongside endDate. Must be ≤ endDate.|
|endDate|query|string|false|Mandatory if startDate is used. End of date range (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339). Must be ≥ startDate.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Max events to return. Default 100, min 1, max 10000.|
|offset|query|integer|false|Events to skip for pagination. Default 0, min 0.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "count": 2,
  "events": [
    {
      "contact_id": 211,
      "event_date": "2024-02-06T20:59:23.383Z",

      "event_filter_id": "abc123",
```

## Create an event

<a id="opIdcreateEvent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/events \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "contact_properties": {
      "AGE": 32,
      "GENDER": "FEMALE"
    },
    "event_date": "2024-02-06T20:59:23.383Z",
    "event_name": "video_played",
    "event_properties": {
      "autoplayed": false,
      "duration": 142,
      "upload_date": "2023-11-24T12:09:10+01:00",
      "video_description": "Create your free account today!",
      "video_title": "Brevo — The most approachable CRM suite"
    },
    "identifiers": {
      "contact_id": 211,
      "email_id": "jane.doe@example.com",
      "ext_id": "abc123",
      "landline_number_id": "+91xxxxxxxxxx",
      "phone_id": "+91xxxxxxxxxx",
      "whatsapp_id": "+91xxxxxxxxxx"
    },
    "object": {
      "identifiers": {
        "ext_id": "sub-59374-linwn",
        "id": "178140"
      },
      "type": "subscription"
    }
  }'
```

## Get the list of all the events for the received emails.

<a id="opIdgetInboundEmailEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/inbound/events \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /inbound/events`

This endpoint will show the list of all the events for the received emails. When no date range is provided, the last 30 days of events are returned by default.

<h3 id="get-the-list-of-all-the-events-for-the-received-emails-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sender|query|string|false|Email address of the sender.|
|startDate|query|string|false|Mandatory if endDate is used. Starting date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) from which you want to fetch the list. Maximum time period that can be selected is 30 days. Must not be in the future.|
|endDate|query|string|false|Mandatory if startDate is used. Ending date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) till which you want to fetch the list. Maximum time period that can be selected is 30 days. Must not be in the future.|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of documents returned per page|
|offset|query|integer(int64)|false|Index of the first document on the page|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "events": [
    {
      "date": "2017-03-11T12:30:00.000Z",
      "recipient": "alexa@example.com",
      "sender": "john@example.com",
      "uuid": "1a825d56-029b-4a41-b8e4-1a825d56"
    },
    {
      "date": "2017-03-12T12:30:00.000Z",
      "recipient": "bob@example.com",
      "sender": "alice@example.com",
      "uuid": "1a825d56-029b-4a41-b8e4-61670463431b"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

## Create balance definition

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/loyalty/balance/programs/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/balance-definitions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "balanceAvailabilityDurationModifier": "noModification",
    "balanceAvailabilityDurationUnit": "day",
    "balanceAvailabilityDurationValue": 0,
    "balanceExpirationDate": "1970-01-01",
    "balanceOptionAmountOvertakingStrategy": "strict",
    "balanceOptionCreditRounding": "lower",
    "balanceOptionDebitRounding": "lower",
    "description": "string",
    "imageRef": "string",
    "maxAmount": 0,
    "maxCreditAmountLimit": 0,
    "maxDebitAmountLimit": 0,
    "meta": {
      "isInternal": true
    },
    "minAmount": 0,
    "name": "string",
    "unit": "POINTS"
  }'
```

`POST /loyalty/balance/programs/{pid}/balance-definitions`

Creates balance definition and returns information

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "balanceAvailabilityDurationModifier": "noModification",
  "balanceAvailabilityDurationUnit": "day",
  "balanceAvailabilityDurationValue": 0,
  "balanceExpirationDate": "1970-01-01",
  "balanceOptionAmountOvertakingStrategy": "strict",
  "balanceOptionCreditRounding": "lower",
  "balanceOptionDebitRounding": "lower",
  "description": "string",
  "imageRef": "string",
  "maxAmount": 0,
  "maxCreditAmountLimit": 0,
  "maxDebitAmountLimit": 0,
  "meta": {
    "isInternal": true
  },
  "minAmount": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "unit": "POINTS"
}
```

<h3 id="create-balance-definition-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pid|path|string(uuid)|true|Loyalty Program Id|
|body|body|object|true|Create Balance Definition Payload|
|» balanceAvailabilityDurationModifier|body|string|false|Defines when the balance expires within the selected duration.|
|» balanceAvailabilityDurationUnit|body|string|false|Unit of time for balance validity.|
|» balanceAvailabilityDurationValue|body|integer|false|Number of time units before the balance expires.|
|» balanceExpirationDate|body|string(date)|false|Fixed expiration date (`dd/mm` format) as an alternative to duration-based expiry.|
|» balanceOptionAmountOvertakingStrategy|body|string|false|Defines whether partial credit is allowed when reaching max balance.|
|» balanceOptionCreditRounding|body|string|false|Defines rounding strategy for credit transactions.|
|» balanceOptionDebitRounding|body|string|false|Defines rounding strategy for debit transactions.|
|» description|body|string|false|Short description of the balance definition.|
|» imageRef|body|string|false|URL of an optional image reference.|
|» maxAmount|body|number|false|Maximum allowable balance amount.|
|» maxCreditAmountLimit|body|number|false|Maximum credit allowed per operation.|
|» maxDebitAmountLimit|body|number|false|Maximum debit allowed per operation.|
|» meta|body|object|false|Additional metadata for the balance definition.|
|» » isInternal|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether the balance definition is internal.|
|» minAmount|body|number|false|Minimum allowable balance amount.|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the balance definition.|
|» unit|body|string|true|Unit of balance measurement.|

## Create new transaction

<a id="opIdbeginTransaction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/loyalty/balance/programs/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/transactions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 0,
    "transactionType": "credit",
    "balanceDefinitionId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "contactId": 1,
    "LoyaltySubscriptionId": "string",
    "meta": {},
    "ttl": 10,
    "eventTime": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "autoComplete": true,
    "balanceExpiryInMinutes": 1
  }'
```

`POST /loyalty/balance/programs/{pid}/transactions`

Creates new transaction and returns information

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount": 0,
  "transactionType": "credit",
  "balanceDefinitionId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "contactId": 1,
  "LoyaltySubscriptionId": "string",
  "meta": {},
  "ttl": 10,
  "eventTime": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "autoComplete": true,
  "balanceExpiryInMinutes": 1
}
```

<h3 id="create-new-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pid|path|string(uuid)|true|Loyalty Program Id|
|body|body|object|true|Transaction Payload|
|» amount|body|number|true|Transaction amount. A positive value creates a credit transaction and a negative value creates a debit transaction (unless transactionType is explicitly provided).|
|» transactionType|body|string|false|Explicit transaction type. If not provided, the type is inferred from the sign of the amount (positive = credit, negative = debit).|
|» balanceDefinitionId|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier (UUID) of the associated balance definition.|
|» contactId|body|integer(int64)|false|Unique identifier of the contact involved in the transaction. Required unless `LoyaltySubscriptionId` is provided.|
|» LoyaltySubscriptionId|body|string|false|Unique identifier for the loyalty subscription. Required unless `contactId` is provided.|
|» meta|body|object|false|Optional metadata associated with the transaction.|
|» ttl|body|integer|false|Time-to-live for the transaction in seconds. Must be at least 10 seconds if provided.|
|» eventTime|body|string(date-time)|false|Timestamp specifying when the transaction event occurred (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format).|
|» autoComplete|body|boolean|false|Whether the transaction should be automatically completed.|
|» balanceExpiryInMinutes|body|integer|false|Expiry time for the balance in minutes. Must be greater than 0 if provided. Only applicable when autoComplete is true.|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|» transactionType|credit|
|» transactionType|debit|

```json
  "completedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "cancelledAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

  "updatedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h1 id="brevo-api-wallet">Wallet</h1>

## Get a pass installation URL for a contact

<a id="opIdgetWalletPassInstallUrl"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/wallet/passes/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/installUrl/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /wallet/passes/{passId}/installUrl/{contactId}`

Generate a wallet installation URL for a specific contact. The returned URL points to the pass installation page and encodes the pass, contact and organization identifiers as an encrypted token, so it can be shared with the contact (email, SMS, QR code, ...) to add the pass to their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.

By default, the `{contactId}` path segment is the numeric Brevo contact ID. To generate an installation URL from a contact's `EXT_ID` attribute (typically an identifier from your own CRM or database) instead, set the `byExtId` query parameter to `true` — the `{contactId}` path segment is then interpreted as the URL-encoded value of the contact's `EXT_ID` attribute. `EXT_ID` is expected to be unique per account; if more than one contact in the account carries the same `EXT_ID`, the request is rejected with `409`.

<h3 id="get-a-pass-installation-url-for-a-contact-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|passId|path|string(uuid)|true|Pass ID. The unique identifier of the wallet pass for which to generate an installation URL.|
|contactId|path|string|true|Contact identifier the installation URL is generated for. Interpretation depends on the `byExtId` query parameter:<br><br>- When `byExtId` is absent or `false` (default), this must be the<br>  numeric Brevo contact ID (positive integer).<br><br>- When `byExtId=true`, this must be the URL-encoded value of the<br>  contact's `EXT_ID` attribute (non-empty string after trimming).|
|byExtId|query|boolean|false|When set to `true`, the `{contactId}` path segment is interpreted as the contact's `EXT_ID` attribute value rather than the numeric Brevo contact ID. Any value other than `true` (including absent, empty, `false`, `1`) keeps the default numeric behaviour.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "url": "https://wallet.brevo.com/pass/eyJhbGciOiJ..."
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

<h3 id="get-a-pass-installation-url-for-a-contact-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Installation URL generated successfully.|[walletPassInstallUrl](#schemawalletpassinstallurl)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid path parameters. Returned when `passId` is not a well-formed UUID, when `contactId` is missing, when `byExtId` is absent/`false` and `contactId` is not a positive integer, or when `byExtId=true` and the provided `EXT_ID` value is empty after trimming.|[errorModel](#schemaerrormodel)|
|401|Unauthorized|Request Authentication Failed.|[errorModel](#schemaerrormodel)|
|403|Forbidden|The pass does not belong to the authenticated account.|[errorModel](#schemaerrormodel)|
|404|Not Found|Not found. Returned when the pass does not exist, or when `byExtId=true` and no contact in the authenticated account has an `EXT_ID` attribute matching the provided value.|[errorModel](#schemaerrormodel)|
|409|Conflict|Ambiguous `EXT_ID`. Returned only when `byExtId=true` and more than one contact in the authenticated account shares the provided `EXT_ID`. Ensure `EXT_ID` values are unique per account before retrying.|[errorModel](#schemaerrormodel)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Wallet is not enabled for this account. The response `code` is `WALLET_NOT_ENABLED`.|[errorModel](#schemaerrormodel)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal error occurred. Includes transient failures while resolving the contact by `EXT_ID`; the request can be retried.|[errorModel](#schemaerrormodel)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api-key, partner-key
</aside>

## Redeem a wallet pass

<a id="opIdredeemWalletPass"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/wallet/passes/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/redeem \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amountSpent": 45.99,
    "customData": {
      "register_id": "POS-12",
      "cashier": "Alice"
    },
    "eventTag": "Summer2026",
    "location": "Mall of America, Minneapolis"
  }'
```

`POST /wallet/passes/{installationId}/redeem`

Record that a wallet pass installation was scanned or redeemed. This issues a `wallet_pass_scanned` event that can trigger automations and update contact segments (for example to track store visits, event attendance or loyalty check-ins). The request body is optional; any details supplied (location, amount spent, event tag, custom data) are carried on the event.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amountSpent": 45.99,
  "customData": {
    "register_id": "POS-12",
    "cashier": "Alice"
  },
  "eventTag": "Summer2026",
  "location": "Mall of America, Minneapolis"
}
```

<h3 id="redeem-a-wallet-pass-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|installationId|path|string(uuid)|true|Installation ID. The unique identifier of the pass installation being redeemed (as issued when the contact added the pass to their wallet).|
|body|body|[walletPassRedeemRequest](#schemawalletpassredeemrequest)|false|Optional details about the scan/redemption.|
|» amountSpent|body|number(float)|false|Amount spent during the visit or transaction. Useful for point-of-sale integrations and purchase tracking.|
|» customData|body|object|false|Arbitrary key/value pairs merged into the scan event's properties, for use in automations and segmentation (e.g. register id, cashier, department). Reserved keys take precedence over the same keys supplied here: `passId` is always set by the endpoint, and `location`, `amountSpent` and `eventTag` are replaced by the matching top-level fields when those are sent.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» eventTag|body|string|false|Free-form tag identifying the event or context of the scan (e.g. an event name a contact attended). Useful to segment or route automations.|
|» location|body|string|false|Location where the scan occurred. Can be a store name, address, or any identifier relevant to your use case.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "message": "Installation redeemed successfully",
  "success": true
}
```

<h1 id="brevo-api-email-campaigns">Email Campaigns</h1>

## Return all your created email campaigns

<a id="opIdgetEmailCampaigns"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /emailCampaigns`

<Note>The response payload for this endpoint has changed
You now need to specify which type of statistics you would like to retrieve. For more information visit [this page](https://developers.brevo.com/changelog/get-all-marketing-campaigns).</Note>

<h3 id="return-all-your-created-email-campaigns-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|false|Filter on the type of the campaigns|
|status|query|string|false|Filter on the status of the campaign|
|statistics|query|string|false|Filter on the type of statistics required. Example: **globalStats** value will only fetch globalStats info of the campaign in the returned response. This option only returns data for events that occurred in the last 6 months. For older campaigns, it is advisable to use the **Get Campaign Report** endpoint.|
|startDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting (urlencoded) UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) to filter the sent email campaigns. **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.** Only available if `status` is not passed or is set to `sent`. The date range between `startDate` and `endDate` must not exceed 2 years. `startDate` must not be in the future.<br>|
|endDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending (urlencoded) UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) to filter the sent email campaigns. **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.** Only available if `status` is not passed or is set to `sent`. The date range between `startDate` and `endDate` must not exceed 2 years. `endDate` must not be in the future.<br>|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of documents per page|
|offset|query|integer(int64)|false|Index of the first document in the page|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed|
|excludeHtmlContent|query|boolean|false|Use this flag to exclude htmlContent from the response body. If set to **true**, the htmlContent field will be returned as an empty string in the response body.|
|excludePdfAttachment|query|boolean|false|Use this flag to filter out campaigns that have a PDF attachment. If set to **true**, only campaigns without a PDF attachment (or with no attachment at all) will be returned.|

## Create an email campaign

<a id="opIdcreateEmailCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "abTesting": true,
    "attachmentUrl": "https://attachment.domain.com",
    "emailExpirationDate": {
      "duration": 30,
      "unit": "weeks"
    },
    "footer": "[DEFAULT_FOOTER]",
    "header": "[DEFAULT_HEADER]",
    "htmlContent": "<!DOCTYPE html> <html> <body> <h1>Confirm you email</h1> <p>Please confirm your email address by clicking on the link below</p> </body> </html>",
    "htmlUrl": "https://html.domain.com",
    "increaseRate": 70,
    "initialQuota": 3000,
    "inlineImageActivation": true,
    "ipWarmupEnable": true,
    "mirrorActive": true,
    "name": "Newsletter - May 2017",
    "params": {
      "FNAME": "Joe",
      "LNAME": "Doe"
    },
    "previewText": "Thanks for your order!",
    "recipients": {
      "exclusionListIds": [
        8
      ],
      "exclusionSegmentIds": [
        13
      ],
      "listIds": [
        32
      ],
      "segmentIds": [
        23
      ]
    },
    "replyTo": "support@myshop.com",
    "scheduledAt": "2017-06-01T12:30:00+02:00",
    "sendAtBestTime": true,
    "sender": {
      "email": "newsletter@myshop.com",
      "id": 3,
      "name": "Mary from MyShop"
    },
    "splitRule": 50,
    "subject": "Discover the New Collection !",
    "subjectA": "Discover the New Collection!",
    "subjectB": "Want to discover the New Collection?",
    "tag": "Newsletter",
    "templateId": 0,
    "toField": "{FNAME} {LNAME}",
    "unsubscriptionPageId": "62cbb7fabbe85021021aac52",
    "updateFormId": "6313436b9ad40e23b371d095",
    "utmCampaign": "NL_05_2017",
    "utmContent": "hero_button",
    "utmId": "promo_042",
    "utmMedium": "email",
    "utmSource": "brevo",
    "utmTerm": "summer_sale",
    "winnerCriteria": "open",
    "winnerDelay": 50
  }'
```

`POST /emailCampaigns`

Create a new email campaign. The campaign requires at minimum a name and sender details, and is created in draft status by default. You must provide email content via one of three mutually exclusive options: htmlContent (inline HTML), htmlUrl (remote URL), or templateId (existing template); additionally, A/B testing can be enabled by setting abTesting to true with subjectA and subjectB, but this is incompatible with sendAtBestTime.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "abTesting": true,
  "attachmentUrl": "https://attachment.domain.com",
  "emailExpirationDate": {
    "duration": 30,
    "unit": "weeks"
  },
  "footer": "[DEFAULT_FOOTER]",
  "header": "[DEFAULT_HEADER]",
  "htmlContent": "<!DOCTYPE html> <html> <body> <h1>Confirm you email</h1> <p>Please confirm your email address by clicking on the link below</p> </body> </html>",
  "htmlUrl": "https://html.domain.com",
  "increaseRate": 70,
  "initialQuota": 3000,
  "inlineImageActivation": true,
  "ipWarmupEnable": true,
  "mirrorActive": true,
  "name": "Newsletter - May 2017",
  "params": {
    "FNAME": "Joe",
    "LNAME": "Doe"
  },
  "previewText": "Thanks for your order!",
  "recipients": {
    "exclusionListIds": [
      8
    ],
    "exclusionSegmentIds": [
      13
    ],
    "listIds": [
      32
    ],
    "segmentIds": [
      23
    ]
  },
```

<h3 id="create-an-email-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Values to create a campaign|
|» abTesting|body|boolean|false|Status of A/B Test. abTesting = false means it is disabled & abTesting = true means it is enabled. **subjectA, subjectB, splitRule, winnerCriteria & winnerDelay** will be considered when abTesting is set to true. subjectA & subjectB are mandatory together & subject if passed is ignored. **Can be set to true only if sendAtBestTime is false**. You will be able to set up two subject lines for your campaign and send them to a random sample of your total recipients. Half of the test group will receive version A, and the other half will receive version B<br>|
|» attachmentUrl|body|string(url)|false|Absolute url of the attachment (no local file). Extension allowed: #### xlsx, xls, ods, docx, docm, doc, csv, pdf, txt, gif, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, rtf, bmp, cgm, css, shtml, html, htm, zip, xml, ppt, pptx, tar, ez, ics, mobi, msg, pub and eps<br>|
|» emailExpirationDate|body|object|false|To reduce your carbon footprint, set an expiration date for your email. If supported, it will be automatically deleted from the recipient’s inbox, saving storage space and energy. Learn more about setting an email expiration date. For reference , ``https://help.brevo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4413566705298-Create-an-email-campaign``|
|» » duration|body|integer(int64)|false|Duration of the email expiry. maximum duration can be 3600 days or 480 weeks or 120 months.|
|» » unit|body|string|false|unit of the duration|
|» footer|body|string|false|Footer of the email campaign|
|» header|body|string|false|Header of the email campaign|
|» htmlContent|body|string|false|**Mandatory if htmlUrl and templateId are empty.** Body of the message (HTML). Must have more than 10 characters and be less than 1MB in size. Cannot be used together with `htmlUrl` or `templateId`.<br>|
|» htmlUrl|body|string(url)|false|**Mandatory if htmlContent and templateId are empty.** URL to the message (HTML). Cannot be used together with `htmlContent` or `templateId`. For example: **https://html.domain.com**<br>|
|» increaseRate|body|integer(int64)|false|**Mandatory if ipWarmupEnable is set to true**. Set a percentage increase rate for warming up your ip. We recommend you set the increase rate to 30% per day. If you want to send the same number of emails every day, set the daily increase value to 0%.<br>|
|» initialQuota|body|integer(int64)|false|**Mandatory if ipWarmupEnable is set to true**. Set an initial quota greater than 1 for warming up your ip. We recommend you set a value of 3000.<br>|
|» inlineImageActivation|body|boolean|false|Use true to embedded the images in your email. Final size of the email should be less than **4MB**. Campaigns with embedded images can _not be sent to more than 5000 contacts_<br>|
|» ipWarmupEnable|body|boolean|false|**Available for dedicated ip clients**. Set this to true if you wish to warm up your ip.<br>|
|» mirrorActive|body|boolean|false|Use true to enable the mirror link|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the campaign|
|» params|body|object|false|Pass the set of attributes to customize the type classic campaign. For example: **{"FNAME":"Joe", "LNAME":"Doe"}**. Only available if **type** is **classic**. It's considered only if campaign is in _New Template Language format_. The New Template Language is dependent on the values of **subject, htmlContent/htmlUrl, sender.name & toField**<br>|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» previewText|body|string|false|Preview text or preheader of the email campaign|
|» recipients|body|object|false|Segment ids and List ids to include/exclude from campaign|
|» » exclusionListIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|List ids to exclude from the campaign|
|» » exclusionSegmentIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|Segment ids which have to be excluded from a campaign.<br>|
|» » listIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|**Mandatory if scheduledAt is not empty**. List Ids to send the campaign to<br>|
|» » segmentIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|**Mandatory if listIds are not used**. Segment ids to send the campaign to.<br>|
|» replyTo|body|string(email)|false|Email on which the campaign recipients will be able to reply to|
|» scheduledAt|body|string|false|Sending UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ). **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result**. If sendAtBestTime is set to true, your campaign will be sent according to the date passed (ignoring the time part). For example: **2017-06-01T12:30:00+02:00**<br>|
|» sendAtBestTime|body|boolean|false|Set this to true if you want to send your campaign at best time.|
|» sender|body|object|true|Sender details including id or email and name (optional). Only one of either Sender’s email or Sender’s ID shall be passed in one request at a time. Passing both `email` and `id` will result in an error. For example: **{"name":"xyz", "email":"example@abc.com"}** or **{"name":"xyz", "id":123}**<br>|
|» » email|body|string(email)|false|Sender email. Must be a valid email address. Cannot be used together with `id` in the same request.<br>|
|» » id|body|integer(int64)|false|Select the sender for the campaign on the basis of sender id. Cannot be used together with `email` in the same request. _In order to select a sender with a specific pool of IPs, dedicated IP users shall pass id (instead of email)._<br>|
|» » name|body|string|false|Sender Name|
|» splitRule|body|integer(int64)|false|Add the size of your test groups. **Mandatory if abTesting = true & 'recipients' is passed**. We'll send version A and B to a random sample of recipients, and then the winning version to everyone else<br>|
|» subject|body|string|false|Subject of the campaign. **Mandatory if abTesting is false**. Ignored if abTesting is true.<br>|
|» subjectA|body|string|false|Subject A of the campaign. **Mandatory if abTesting = true**. subjectA & subjectB should have unique value<br>|
|» subjectB|body|string|false|Subject B of the campaign. **Mandatory if abTesting = true**. subjectA & subjectB should have unique value<br>|
|» tag|body|string|false|Tag of the campaign|
|» templateId|body|integer(int64)|false|**Mandatory if htmlContent and htmlUrl are empty.** Id of the transactional email template with status _active_. Used to copy only its content fetched from htmlContent/htmlUrl to an email campaign for RSS feature. Cannot be used together with `htmlContent` or `htmlUrl`.<br>|
|» toField|body|string|false|To personalize the **To** Field. If you want to include the first name and last name of your recipient, add **{FNAME} {LNAME}**. These contact attributes must already exist in your Brevo account. If input parameter **params** used please use **{{contact.FNAME}} {{contact.LNAME}}** for personalization<br>|
|» unsubscriptionPageId|body|string|false|Enter an unsubscription page id. The page id is a 24 digit alphanumeric id that can be found in the URL when editing the page. If not entered, then the default unsubscription page will be used.<br>|
|» updateFormId|body|string|false|**Mandatory if templateId is used containing the {{ update_profile }} tag**. Enter an update profile form id. The form id is a 24 digit alphanumeric id that can be found in the URL when editing the form. If not entered, then the default update profile form will be used.<br>|
|» utmCampaign|body|string|false|Customize the utm_campaign value. If this field is empty, the campaign name will be used. Only alphanumeric characters and spaces are allowed|
|» utmContent|body|string|false|Customize the utm_content value. Appears on outgoing tracking links alongside utm_campaign. Only alphanumeric characters and spaces are allowed|
|» utmId|body|string|false|Customize the utm_id value. Appears on outgoing tracking links alongside utm_campaign. When omitted or empty, the utm_id entry from the account's global utm_settings is used if enabled; otherwise no utm_id parameter is emitted.|
|» utmMedium|body|string|false|Customize the utm_medium value. When omitted or empty, the utm_medium entry from the account's global utm_settings is used if set; otherwise the default `email` is used.|
|» utmSource|body|string|false|Customize the utm_source value. When omitted or empty, the utm_source entry from the account's global utm_settings is used if set; otherwise the account default (`brevo` or `sendinblue`) is used.|
|» utmTerm|body|string|false|Customize the utm_term value. Appears on outgoing tracking links alongside utm_campaign. Only alphanumeric characters and spaces are allowed|
|» winnerCriteria|body|string|false|Choose the metrics that will determinate the winning version. **Mandatory if _splitRule_ >= 1 and < 50**. If splitRule = 50, `winnerCriteria` is ignored if passed<br>|
|» winnerDelay|body|integer(int64)|false|Choose the duration of the test in hours. Maximum is 7 days, pass 24*7 = 168 hours. The winning version will be sent at the end of the test. **Mandatory if _splitRule_ >= 1 and < 50**. If splitRule = 50, `winnerDelay` is ignored if passed<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » unit|days|
|» » unit|weeks|
|» » unit|months|
|» winnerCriteria|open|
|» winnerCriteria|click|

## Upload an image to your account's image gallery

<a id="opIduploadImageToGallery"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns/images \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "imageUrl": "https://somedomain.com/image1.jpg",
    "name": "product-banner.png"
  }'
```

`POST /emailCampaigns/images`

Upload an image to your account''s image gallery by providing an absolute URL to the image. The maximum allowed image size is 2MB and supported formats are jpeg, jpg, png, bmp, and gif; local file uploads are not supported.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "imageUrl": "https://somedomain.com/image1.jpg",
  "name": "product-banner.png"
}
```

<h3 id="upload-an-image-to-your-accounts-image-gallery-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters to upload an image|
|» imageUrl|body|string|true|The absolute url of the image (**no local file**). Maximum allowed size for image is **2MB**. Allowed extensions for images are: #### jpeg, jpg, png, bmp, gif.<br>|
|» name|body|string|false|Name shown in your Brevo image gallery. Include the file extension, e.g. product-banner.png|

## Get an email campaign report

<a id="opIdgetEmailCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}`

Retrieve detailed information about a specific email campaign by its ID, including recipients, statistics, and HTML content. Use the statistics query parameter to select which statistics to include (globalStats, linksStats, statsByDomain, statsByDevice, or statsByBrowser); statsByDevice and statsByBrowser are only available on this single-campaign endpoint. You can exclude HTML content from the response by setting excludeHtmlContent to true.

<h3 id="get-an-email-campaign-report-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|Id of the campaign|
|statistics|query|string|false|Filter on the type of statistics required. Example: **globalStats** value will only fetch globalStats info of the campaign in the returned response. `statsByDevice` and `statsByBrowser` are only available when retrieving a single campaign (not in the list endpoint).|
|excludeHtmlContent|query|boolean|false|Use this flag to exclude htmlContent from the response body. If set to **true**, htmlContent field will be returned as empty string in the response body|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|statistics|globalStats|
|statistics|linksStats|
|statistics|statsByDomain|
|statistics|statsByDevice|
|statistics|statsByBrowser|
|excludeHtmlContent|true|
|excludeHtmlContent|false|

<h3 id="get-an-email-campaign-report-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attachmentFile|string|false|none|Url of the attachment file. Only available if the campaign has an attachment.|
|abTesting|boolean|false|none|Status of A/B Test for the campaign. abTesting = false means it is disabled, & abTesting = true means it is enabled.|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the campaign|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the campaign|
|previewText|string|false|none|Preview text or preheader of the email campaign|
|scheduledAt|string|false|none|UTC date-time on which campaign is scheduled (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)|
|sendAtBestTime|boolean|false|none|It is true if you have chosen to send your campaign at best time, otherwise it is false|
|splitRule|integer|false|none|The size of your ab-test groups. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|status|string|true|none|Status of the campaign|
|subject|string|false|none|Subject of the campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `false`|
|subjectA|string|false|none|Subject A of the ab-test campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|subjectB|string|false|none|Subject B of the ab-test campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|type|string|true|none|Type of campaign|
|winnerCriteria|string|false|none|Criteria for the winning version. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|winnerDelay|integer|false|none|The duration of the test in hours at the end of which the winning version will be sent. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|attachmentUrl|string|false|none|URL of the attachment file associated with the campaign. Empty string if no attachment is present.|
|createdAt|string|true|none|Creation UTC date-time of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)|
|emailExpirationDate|object|false|none|Expiration date configuration for the email campaign, if set. Contains the duration and unit of the email expiry.|
|» duration|integer(int64)|false|none|Duration of the email expiry|
|» unit|string|false|none|Unit of the duration|
|footer|string|true|none|Footer of the campaign|
|header|string|true|none|Header of the campaign|
|htmlContent|string|true|none|HTML content of the campaign|
|inlineImageActivation|boolean|false|none|Status of inline image. inlineImageActivation = false means image can’t be embedded, & inlineImageActivation = true means image can be embedded, in the email.|
|mirrorActive|boolean|false|none|Status of mirror links in campaign. mirrorActive = false means mirror links are deactivated, & mirrorActive = true means mirror links are activated, in the campaign|
|modifiedAt|string|true|none|UTC date-time of last modification of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)|
|recurring|boolean|false|none|FOR TRIGGER ONLY ! Type of trigger campaign.recurring = false means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign only once, & recurring = true means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign several times|
|replyTo|string(email)|true|none|Email defined as the "Reply to" of the campaign|
|returnBounce|integer(int64)|false|none|Total number of non-delivered campaigns for a particular campaign id.|
|sender|object|true|none|none|
|» email|string(email)|false|none|Sender email of the campaign|
|» id|integer(int64)|false|none|Sender id of the campaign|

For customer-supplied non-numeric values (for example `promo_042`), read `utmId` (string) instead. Kept for backward compatibility.|

## Update an email campaign

<a id="opIdupdateEmailCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "abTesting": true,
    "attachmentUrl": "https://attachment.domain.com",
    "emailExpirationDate": {
      "duration": 30,
      "unit": "weeks"
    },
    "footer": "[DEFAULT_FOOTER]",
    "header": "[DEFAULT_HEADER]",
    "htmlContent": "<!DOCTYPE html> <html> <body> <h1>Confirm you email</h1> <p>Please confirm your email address by clicking on the link below</p> </body> </html>",
    "htmlUrl": "https://html.domain.com",
    "increaseRate": 70,
    "initialQuota": 3000,
    "inlineImageActivation": true,
    "ipWarmupEnable": true,
    "mirrorActive": true,
    "name": "Newsletter - May 2017",
    "params": {
      "FNAME": "Joe",
      "LNAME": "Doe"
    },
    "previewText": "Thanks for your order!",
    "recipients": {
      "exclusionListIds": [
        8
      ],
      "exclusionSegmentIds": [
        13
      ],
      "listIds": [
        32
      ],
      "segmentIds": [
        23
      ]
    },
    "recurring": false,
    "replyTo": "support@myshop.com",
    "scheduledAt": "2017-06-01T12:30:00+02:00",
    "sendAtBestTime": true,
    "sender": {
      "email": "newsletter@myshop.com",
      "id": 3,
      "name": "Mary from MyShop"
    },
    "splitRule": 50,
    "subject": "Discover the New Collection !",
    "subjectA": "Discover the New Collection!",
    "subjectB": "Want to discover the New Collection?",
    "tag": "Newsletter",
    "toField": "{FNAME} {LNAME}",
    "unsubscriptionPageId": "62cbb7fabbe85021021aac52",
    "updateFormId": "6313436b9ad40e23b371d095",
    "utmCampaign": "NL_05_2017",
    "utmContent": "hero_button",
    "utmId": "promo_042",
    "utmMedium": "email",
    "utmSource": "brevo",
    "utmTerm": "summer_sale",
    "winnerCriteria": "open",
    "winnerDelay": 50
  }'
```

`PUT /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}`

Update an existing email campaign''s properties such as name, subject, content, sender, recipients, schedule, and A/B testing configuration. The campaign must exist and the request body must contain at least one valid field to update. Only draft or scheduled campaigns can be modified; if sendAtBestTime is enabled, IP warmup will be automatically disabled.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "abTesting": true,
  "attachmentUrl": "https://attachment.domain.com",
  "emailExpirationDate": {
    "duration": 30,
    "unit": "weeks"
  },
  "footer": "[DEFAULT_FOOTER]",
  "header": "[DEFAULT_HEADER]",
  "htmlContent": "<!DOCTYPE html> <html> <body> <h1>Confirm you email</h1> <p>Please confirm your email address by clicking on the link below</p> </body> </html>",
  "htmlUrl": "https://html.domain.com",
  "increaseRate": 70,
  "initialQuota": 3000,
  "inlineImageActivation": true,
  "ipWarmupEnable": true,
  "mirrorActive": true,
  "name": "Newsletter - May 2017",
  "params": {
    "FNAME": "Joe",
    "LNAME": "Doe"
  },
  "previewText": "Thanks for your order!",
  "recipients": {
    "exclusionListIds": [
      8
    ],
    "exclusionSegmentIds": [
      13
    ],
    "listIds": [
      32
    ],
    "segmentIds": [
      23
    ]
  },
  "recurring": false,
  "replyTo": "support@myshop.com",
  "scheduledAt": "2017-06-01T12:30:00+02:00",
  "sendAtBestTime": true,
  "sender": {
    "email": "newsletter@myshop.com",
    "id": 3,
    "name": "Mary from MyShop"
  },
  "splitRule": 50,
  "subject": "Discover the New Collection !",
  "subjectA": "Discover the New Collection!",
  "subjectB": "Want to discover the New Collection?",
  "tag": "Newsletter",
  "toField": "{FNAME} {LNAME}",
  "unsubscriptionPageId": "62cbb7fabbe85021021aac52",
  "updateFormId": "6313436b9ad40e23b371d095",
  "utmCampaign": "NL_05_2017",
  "utmContent": "hero_button",
  "utmId": "promo_042",
  "utmMedium": "email",
  "utmSource": "brevo",
  "utmTerm": "summer_sale",
  "winnerCriteria": "open",
  "winnerDelay": 50
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-email-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|Id of the campaign|
|body|body|object|true|Values to update a campaign|
|» abTesting|body|boolean|false|Status of A/B Test. abTesting = false means it is disabled & abTesting = true means it is enabled. **subjectA, subjectB, splitRule, winnerCriteria & winnerDelay** will be considered when abTesting is set to true. subjectA & subjectB are mandatory together & subject if passed is ignored. **Can be set to true only if sendAtBestTime is false**. You will be able to set up two subject lines for your campaign and send them to a random sample of your total recipients. Half of the test group will receive version A, and the other half will receive version B<br>|
|» attachmentUrl|body|string(url)|false|Absolute url of the attachment (no local file). Extension allowed: #### xlsx, xls, ods, docx, docm, doc, csv, pdf, txt, gif, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, rtf, bmp, cgm, css, shtml, html, htm, zip, xml, ppt, pptx, tar, ez, ics, mobi, msg, pub and eps'<br>|
|» emailExpirationDate|body|object|false|To reduce your carbon footprint, set an expiration date for your email. If supported, it will be automatically deleted from the recipient’s inbox, saving storage space and energy.|
|» » duration|body|integer(int64)|false|Duration of the email expiry. maximum duration can be 3600 days or 480 weeks or 120 months.|
|» » unit|body|string|false|unit of the duration|
|» footer|body|string|false|Footer of the email campaign|
|» header|body|string|false|Header of the email campaign|
|» htmlContent|body|string|false|Body of the message (HTML version). If the campaign is designed using Drag & Drop editor via HTML content, then the design page will not have Drag & Drop editor access for that campaign. **REQUIRED if htmlUrl is empty**<br>|
|» htmlUrl|body|string(url)|false|Url which contents the body of the email message. **REQUIRED if htmlContent is empty**<br>|
|» increaseRate|body|integer(int64)|false|Set a percentage increase rate for warming up your ip. We recommend you set the increase rate to 30% per day. If you want to send the same number of emails every day, set the daily increase value to 0%.<br>|
|» initialQuota|body|integer(int64)|false|Set an initial quota greater than 1 for warming up your ip. We recommend you set a value of 3000.<br>|
|» inlineImageActivation|body|boolean|false|Status of inline image. inlineImageActivation = false means image can’t be embedded, & inlineImageActivation = true means image can be embedded, in the email. You cannot send a campaign of more than **4MB** with images embedded in the email. Campaigns with the images embedded in the email _must be sent to less than 5000 contacts_.<br>|
|» ipWarmupEnable|body|boolean|false|**Available for dedicated ip clients**. Set this to true if you wish to warm up your ip.<br>|
|» mirrorActive|body|boolean|false|Status of mirror links in campaign. mirrorActive = false means mirror links are deactivated, & mirrorActive = true means mirror links are activated, in the campaign|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the campaign|
|» params|body|object|false|Pass the set of attributes to customize the type classic campaign. For example: **{"FNAME":"Joe", "LNAME":"Doe"}**. Only available if **type** is **classic**. It's considered only if campaign is in _New Template Language format_. The New Template Language is dependent on the values of **subject, htmlContent/htmlUrl, sender.name & toField**<br>|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» previewText|body|string|false|Preview text or preheader of the email campaign|
|» recipients|body|object|false|Segment ids and List ids to include/exclude from campaign|
|» » exclusionListIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|List ids which have to be excluded from a campaign|
|» » exclusionSegmentIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|Segment ids which have to be excluded from a campaign.<br>|
|» » listIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|Lists Ids to send the campaign to. **Campaign should only be updated with listIds if listIds were used to create it. REQUIRED if already not present in campaign and scheduledAt is not empty**<br>|
|» » segmentIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|**Mandatory if listIds are not used. Campaign should only be updated with segmentIds if segmentIds were used to create it.** Segment ids to send the campaign to.<br>|
|» recurring|body|boolean|false|**FOR TRIGGER ONLY !** Type of trigger campaign.recurring = false means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign only once, & recurring = true means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign several times<br>|
|» replyTo|body|string(email)|false|Email on which campaign recipients will be able to reply to|
|» scheduledAt|body|string|false|UTC date-time on which the campaign has to run (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ). **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.** If sendAtBestTime is set to true, your campaign will be sent according to the date passed (ignoring the time part).<br>|
|» sendAtBestTime|body|boolean|false|Set this to true if you want to send your campaign at best time. Note:- **if true, warmup ip will be disabled.**<br>|
|» sender|body|object|false|Sender details including id or email and name (optional). Only one of either Sender's email or Sender's ID shall be passed in one request at a time. For example: **{"name":"xyz", "email":"example@abc.com"}** **{"name":"xyz", "id":123}**<br>|
|» » email|body|string(email)|false|Sender email from which the campaign emails are sent|
|» » id|body|integer(int64)|false|Select the sender for the campaign on the basis of sender id. **In order to select a sender with specific pool of IP’s, dedicated ip users shall pass id (instead of email)**.<br>|
|» » name|body|string|false|Sender Name from which the campaign emails are sent|
|» splitRule|body|integer(int64)|false|Add the size of your test groups. **Mandatory if abTesting = true & 'recipients' is passed**. We'll send version A and B to a random sample of recipients, and then the winning version to everyone else<br>|
|» subject|body|string|false|Subject of the campaign|
|» subjectA|body|string|false|Subject A of the campaign. **Mandatory if abTesting = true**. subjectA & subjectB should have unique value<br>|
|» subjectB|body|string|false|Subject B of the campaign. **Mandatory if abTesting = true**. subjectA & subjectB should have unique value<br>|
|» tag|body|string|false|Tag of the campaign|
|» toField|body|string|false|To personalize the **To** Field. If you want to include the first name and last name of your recipient, add **{FNAME} {LNAME}**. These contact attributes must already exist in your Brevo account. If input parameter **params** used please use **{{contact.FNAME}} {{contact.LNAME}}** for personalization<br>|
|» unsubscriptionPageId|body|string|false|Enter an unsubscription page id. The page id is a 24 digit alphanumeric id that can be found in the URL when editing the page.<br>|
|» updateFormId|body|string|false|**Mandatory if templateId is used containing the {{ update_profile }} tag**. Enter an update profile form id. The form id is a 24 digit alphanumeric id that can be found in the URL when editing the form.<br>|
|» utmCampaign|body|string|false|Customize the utm_campaign value. If this field is empty, the campaign name will be used. Only alphanumeric characters and spaces are allowed|
|» utmContent|body|string|false|Customize the utm_content value. Appears on outgoing tracking links alongside utm_campaign. Only alphanumeric characters and spaces are allowed|
|» utmId|body|string|false|Customize the utm_id value. Appears on outgoing tracking links alongside utm_campaign. When omitted or empty, the utm_id entry from the account's global utm_settings is used if enabled; otherwise no utm_id parameter is emitted.|
|» utmMedium|body|string|false|Customize the utm_medium value. When omitted or empty, the utm_medium entry from the account's global utm_settings is used if set; otherwise the default `email` is used.|
|» utmSource|body|string|false|Customize the utm_source value. When omitted or empty, the utm_source entry from the account's global utm_settings is used if set; otherwise the account default (`brevo` or `sendinblue`) is used.|
|» utmTerm|body|string|false|Customize the utm_term value. Appears on outgoing tracking links alongside utm_campaign. Only alphanumeric characters and spaces are allowed|
|» winnerCriteria|body|string|false|Choose the metrics that will determinate the winning version. **Mandatory if _splitRule_ >= 1 and < 50**. If splitRule = 50, `winnerCriteria` is ignored if passed<br>|
|» winnerDelay|body|integer(int64)|false|Choose the duration of the test in hours. Maximum is 7 days, pass 24*7 = 168 hours. The winning version will be sent at the end of the test. **Mandatory if _splitRule_ >= 1 and < 50**. If splitRule = 50, `winnerDelay` is ignored if passed<br>|

|» » unit|weeks|
|» » unit|months|
|» winnerCriteria|open|
|» winnerCriteria|click|

## Delete an email campaign

<a id="opIddeleteEmailCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}`

Delete an email campaign by its campaign ID. Only campaigns that have not been scheduled can be deleted; attempting to delete a campaign that has already been scheduled will return a 403 permission denied error. Related data in templates, newsletter builder, and schedule collections is also cleaned up.

<h3 id="delete-an-email-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the campaign|


## Export the recipients of an email campaign

<a id="opIdemailExportRecipients"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns/0/exportRecipients \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "notifyURL": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
    "recipientsType": "openers"
  }'
```

`POST /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}/exportRecipients`

Export the recipients of a sent email campaign as an asynchronous process, filtered by recipient type (e.g. openers, clickers, hardBounces). The recipientsType field is required and determines which subset of recipients to export. An optional notifyURL webhook will be called once the export is complete, and the response returns a processId to track the export status.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "notifyURL": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
  "recipientsType": "openers"
}
```

<h3 id="export-the-recipients-of-an-email-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|Id of the campaign|
|body|body|object|false|Values to send for a recipient export request|
|» notifyURL|body|string(url)|false|Webhook called once the export process is finished. For reference, https://help.brevo.com/hc/en-us/articles/360007666479|
|» recipientsType|body|string|true|Type of recipients to export for a campaign|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» recipientsType|all|
|» recipientsType|nonClickers|
|» recipientsType|nonOpeners|
|» recipientsType|clickers|
|» recipientsType|openers|
|» recipientsType|softBounces|
|» recipientsType|hardBounces|
|» recipientsType|unsubscribed|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "processId": 78
}
```

```json
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"

}
```

## Send an email campaign immediately, based on campaignId

<a id="opIdsendEmailCampaignNow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns/0/sendNow \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}/sendNow`

Send an existing email campaign immediately by scheduling it for the current time. The campaign must have valid recipients and content configured before sending. The system verifies your account''s send limit and credit balance before dispatching; if credits are insufficient, a 402 error is returned.

## Send an email campaign to your test list

<a id="opIdsendTestEmail"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/emailCampaigns/0/sendTest \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "emailTo": [
      "helen.jurger@example.com"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}/sendTest`

Send a test version of an email campaign to specified email addresses or your entire test list. If the emailTo array is left empty, the test mail will be sent to all addresses in your test list. You can send a maximum of 50 test emails per day.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "emailTo": [
    "helen.jurger@example.com"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="send-an-email-campaign-to-your-test-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|Id of the campaign|
|body|body|[sendTestEmail](#schemasendtestemail)|true|none|
|» emailTo|body|[string(email)]|false|List of the email addresses of the recipients whom you wish to send the test mail. _If left empty, the test mail will be sent to your entire test list. You can not send more than 50 test emails per day_.<br>|

> Example responses

<h1 id="brevo-api-sms-campaigns">SMS Campaigns</h1>

## Returns the information for all your created SMS campaigns

<a id="opIdgetSmsCampaigns"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /smsCampaigns`

Retrieve a paginated list of all your SMS campaigns with their statistics and recipient information. Results can be filtered by status and date range, with a default limit of 500 and maximum of 1000 per page. The sort order defaults to descending by creation date; date filters are only available when status is not passed or is set to sent.

<h3 id="returns-the-information-for-all-your-created-sms-campaigns-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|query|string|false|Status of campaign.|
|startDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting (urlencoded) UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) to filter the sent SMS campaigns. **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.** Only available if `status` is not passed or is set to `sent`. `startDate` must not be in the future.<br>|
|endDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending (urlencoded) UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) to filter the sent SMS campaigns. **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.** Only available if `status` is not passed or is set to `sent`. `endDate` must not be in the future.<br>|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of documents per page|
|offset|query|integer(int64)|false|Beginning point in the list to retrieve from.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|suspended|
|status|archive|
|status|sent|
|status|queued|
|status|draft|
|status|inProcess|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

## Creates an SMS campaign

<a id="opIdcreateSmsCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "content": "Get a discount by visiting our NY store and saying : Happy Spring!",
    "name": "Spring Promo Code",
    "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
    "recipients": {
      "exclusionListIds": [
        15
      ],
      "listIds": [
        54
      ]
    },
    "scheduledAt": "2017-05-05T12:30:00+02:00",
    "sender": "MyShop",
    "unicodeEnabled": true,
    "unsubscribeInstruction": "send Stop if you want to unsubscribe."
  }'
```

`POST /smsCampaigns`

Create a new SMS campaign with the required name, sender, and content fields. The sender name is limited to 11 alphanumeric characters or 15 numeric characters, and the content should stay within 160 characters per SMS segment. If a scheduledAt date is provided, listIds in recipients become mandatory; accounts under validation are limited to 4 total campaigns and campaigns with more than 10 recipients will be saved as draft.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "content": "Get a discount by visiting our NY store and saying : Happy Spring!",
  "name": "Spring Promo Code",
  "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
  "recipients": {
    "exclusionListIds": [
      15
    ],
    "listIds": [
      54
    ]
  },
  "scheduledAt": "2017-05-05T12:30:00+02:00",
  "sender": "MyShop",
  "unicodeEnabled": true,
  "unsubscribeInstruction": "send Stop if you want to unsubscribe."
}
```

<h3 id="creates-an-sms-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Values to create an SMS Campaign|
|» content|body|string|true|Content of the message. The **maximum characters used per SMS is 160**, if used more than that, it will be counted as more than one SMS.<br>|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the campaign|
|» organisationPrefix|body|string|false|A recognizable prefix will ensure your audience knows who you are. Recommended by U.S. carriers. This will be added as your Brand Name before the message content. **Prefer verifying maximum length of 160 characters including this prefix in message content to avoid multiple sending of same sms.**|
|» recipients|body|object|false|none|
|» » exclusionListIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|List ids which have to be excluded from a campaign|
|» » listIds|body|[integer(int64)]|true|Lists Ids to send the campaign to. **REQUIRED if scheduledAt is not empty**<br>|
|» scheduledAt|body|string|false|UTC date-time on which the campaign has to run (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ). **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.**<br>|

## Get an SMS campaign

<a id="opIdgetSmsCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /smsCampaigns/{campaignId}`

Retrieve detailed information about a specific SMS campaign by its ID, including campaign content, sender, recipients with list names, statistics (delivered, sent, bounces, unsubscriptions, answered), and tags. Unlike the list endpoint, recipients are returned as objects with id and name fields rather than plain IDs.

<h3 id="get-an-sms-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the SMS campaign|

## Update an SMS campaign

<a id="opIdupdateSmsCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "content": "Get a discount by visiting our NY store and saying : Happy Spring!",
    "name": "Spring Promo Code",
    "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
    "recipients": {
      "exclusionListIds": [
        15
      ],
      "listIds": [
        54
      ]
    },
    "scheduledAt": "2017-05-05T12:30:00+02:00",
    "sender": "MyShop",
    "unicodeEnabled": true,
    "unsubscribeInstruction": "send Stop if you want to unsubscribe."
  }'
```

`PUT /smsCampaigns/{campaignId}`

Update an existing SMS campaign''s properties such as name, sender, content, recipients, scheduled date, organisation prefix, and unsubscribe instructions. The request body must contain at least one valid field to update. The campaign must exist and must be of type SMS; if a scheduledAt is provided, valid recipients must be present either in the request or already configured on the campaign.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "content": "Get a discount by visiting our NY store and saying : Happy Spring!",
  "name": "Spring Promo Code",
  "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
  "recipients": {
    "exclusionListIds": [
      15
    ],
    "listIds": [
      54
    ]
  },
  "scheduledAt": "2017-05-05T12:30:00+02:00",
  "sender": "MyShop",
  "unicodeEnabled": true,
  "unsubscribeInstruction": "send Stop if you want to unsubscribe."
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-sms-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the SMS campaign|
|body|body|object|true|Values to update an SMS Campaign|
|» content|body|string|false|Content of the message. The **maximum characters used per SMS is 160**, if used more than that, it will be counted as more than one SMS<br>|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the campaign|
|» organisationPrefix|body|string|false|A recognizable prefix will ensure your audience knows who you are. Recommended by U.S. carriers. This will be added as your Brand Name before the message content. **Prefer verifying maximum length of 160 characters including this prefix in message content to avoid multiple sending of same sms.**|
|» recipients|body|object|false|none|
|» » exclusionListIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|List ids which have to be excluded from a campaign|
|» » listIds|body|[integer(int64)]|true|Lists Ids to send the campaign to. **REQUIRED if scheduledAt is not empty**<br>|
|» scheduledAt|body|string|false|UTC date-time on which the campaign has to run (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ). **Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.**<br>|
|» sender|body|string|false|Name of the sender. **The number of characters is limited to 11 for alphanumeric characters and 15 for numeric characters**<br>|
|» unicodeEnabled|body|boolean|false|Format of the message. It indicates whether the content should be treated as unicode or not.<br>|
|» unsubscribeInstruction|body|string|false|Instructions to unsubscribe from future communications. Recommended by U.S. carriers. Must include **STOP** keyword. This will be added as instructions after the end of message content. **Prefer verifying maximum length of 160 characters including this instructions in message content to avoid multiple sending of same sms.**|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}
```

## Delete an SMS campaign

<a id="opIddeleteSmsCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /smsCampaigns/{campaignId}`

Delete an SMS campaign by its campaign ID. Only campaigns that have not been scheduled or sent can be deleted; attempting to delete a campaign that is queued, in process, or has been sent with recipients will return a 403 permission denied error.

<h3 id="delete-an-sms-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

## Export an SMS campaign's recipients

<a id="opIdrequestSmsRecipientExport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns/0/exportRecipients \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "notifyURL": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
    "recipientsType": "answered"
  }'
```

`POST /smsCampaigns/{campaignId}/exportRecipients`

It returns the background process ID which on completion calls the notify URL that you have set in the input.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "notifyURL": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
  "recipientsType": "answered"
}
```

<h3 id="export-an-sms-campaigns-recipients-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the campaign|
|body|body|object|false|Values to send for a recipient export request|
|» notifyURL|body|string(url)|false|URL that will be called once the export process is finished. For reference, https://help.brevo.com/hc/en-us/articles/360007666479|
|» recipientsType|body|string|true|Filter the recipients based on how they interacted with the campaign|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

|» recipientsType|all|
|» recipientsType|delivered|
|» recipientsType|answered|

## Send your SMS campaign immediately

<a id="opIdsendSmsCampaignNow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns/0/sendNow \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /smsCampaigns/{campaignId}/sendNow`

Send an existing SMS campaign immediately by scheduling it for the current time. The system verifies your account''s SMS credit balance before dispatching; if credits are insufficient or the remaining credit is less than the number of recipients, a 402 error is returned. The campaign must have valid recipients and content already configured.

<h3 id="send-your-sms-campaign-immediately-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the campaign|

## Send a test SMS campaign

<a id="opIdsendTestSms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns/0/sendTest \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "phoneNumber": "33689965433"
  }'
```

`POST /smsCampaigns/{campaignId}/sendTest`

Send a test SMS to a specified phone number to preview the campaign before sending it to all recipients. The phone number must belong to one of your existing contacts in your Brevo account and must not be blacklisted. The number should include the country code (e.g. 33689965433).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "phoneNumber": "33689965433"
}
```

<h3 id="send-a-test-sms-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|Id of the SMS campaign|
|body|body|object|true|Mobile number of the recipient with the country code. This number **must belong to one of your contacts in Brevo account and must not be blacklisted**<br>|
|» phoneNumber|body|string|false|Mobile number of the recipient with the country code. This number **must belong to one of your contacts in Brevo account and must not be blacklisted**<br>|

```json
  "code": "invalid_parameter",

    "3542388988@mailin.com, 10976444477@mailin.com"

}
```

## Update a campaign's status

<a id="opIdupdateSmsCampaignStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/smsCampaigns/0/status \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '"sent"'
```

`PUT /smsCampaigns/{campaignId}/status`

Update the status of an SMS campaign, such as suspending, archiving, or replicating it. Available status values include suspended, archive, darchive, sent, queued, replicate, replicateTemplate, cancel, and draft. Note that the replicateTemplate status is only available for template type campaigns.

> Body parameter

```json
"sent"
```

<h3 id="update-a-campaigns-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|integer(int64)|true|id of the campaign|
|body|body|[updateCampaignStatus](#schemaupdatecampaignstatus)|true|Status of the campaign.|
|» status|body|string|false|Note:- **replicateTemplate** status will be available **only for template type campaigns.**<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|suspended|
|» status|archive|
|» status|darchive|
|» status|sent|
|» status|queued|
|» status|replicate|
|» status|replicateTemplate|
|» status|cancel|
|» status|draft|
