## Send SMS message asynchronously to a mobile number

<a id="opIdsendAsyncTransactionalSms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/transactionalSMS/send \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
    "recipient": "33689965433",
    "sender": "MyShop",
    "tag": "accountValidation",
    "type": "marketing",
    "unicodeEnabled": true,
    "webUrl": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
    "params": {
      "FNAME": "Joe",
      "LNAME": "Doe"
    },
    "templateId": 123,
    "content": null
  }'
```

`POST /transactionalSMS/send`

<Note>If the user includes stop code in the Transactional SMS, then it will be switched to Marketing SMS automatically and it will be interpreted as a Marketing SMS. To send Transactional SMS as Transactional, it is important not to use stop code.
Note: For adding a stop code, client has to add reply STOP to [STOP_CODE] and the [STOP_CODE] will be replaced with the number.</Note>
<Note title="For end users in France">Transactional SMS can be sent at any time without time restrictions. However, if a message is categorized as Marketing, it must adhere to specific time restrictions. Messages sent outside of these restricted hours will experience delays and will be processed during allowable times. Specifically, Marketing SMS cannot be processed between 10pm and 8am, on Sundays, and on French public holidays.</Note>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
  "recipient": "33689965433",
  "sender": "MyShop",
  "tag": "accountValidation",
  "type": "marketing",
  "unicodeEnabled": true,
  "webUrl": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
  "params": {
    "FNAME": "Joe",
    "LNAME": "Doe"
  },
  "templateId": 123,
  "content": null
}
```

<h3 id="send-sms-message-asynchronously-to-a-mobile-number-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[sendTransacSms](#schemasendtransacsms)|true|Values to send a transactional SMS|
|» organisationPrefix|body|string|false|A recognizable prefix will ensure your audience knows who you are. Recommended by U.S. carriers. This will be added as your Brand Name before the message content. **Prefer verifying maximum length of 160 characters including this prefix in message content to avoid multiple sending of same sms.**|
|» recipient|body|string|true|Mobile number to send SMS with the country code. Must contain between 6 and 15 digits, optionally prefixed with '+'.<br>|
|» sender|body|string|true|Name of the sender. **The number of characters is limited to 11 for alphanumeric characters and 15 for numeric characters.** Alphanumeric sender names (up to 11 characters) must contain only letters and digits. Numeric sender names (12-15 characters) must contain only digits.<br>|
|» tag|body|string \| [string]|false|Tag of the message. Can be a single string or an array of strings (maximum 10 tags). Each tag must be a non-empty string.<br>|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» type|body|string|false|Type of the SMS. Marketing SMS messages are those sent typically with marketing content. Transactional SMS messages are sent to individuals and are triggered in response to some action, such as a sign-up, purchase, etc.|
|» unicodeEnabled|body|boolean|false|Format of the message. It indicates whether the content should be treated as unicode or not.<br>|
|» webUrl|body|string(url)|false|Webhook to call for each event triggered by the message (delivered etc.)|
|» params|body|object|false|Pass the set of attributes to customize the template. For example, {"FNAME":"Joe", "LNAME":"Doe"}. These are the placeholder variables in the template that will be replaced with the corresponding values passed in the params object. Applicable only if `templateId` is used.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|Send SMS using a template ID.|
|» templateId|body|integer|true|Template ID to send SMS with the template. When provided, overrides the content parameter. Mandatory if 'content' is not passed.|
|» content|body|object|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|Send SMS using direct content.|
|» content|body|string|true|Content of the message. If more than **160 characters** long, will be sent as multiple text messages. Mandatory if 'templateId' is not passed, ignored if 'templateId' is passed.<br>|
|» templateId|body|object|false|none|

|» type|marketing|

## Send SMS message to a mobile number

<a id="opIdsendTransacSms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/transactionalSMS/sms \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
    "recipient": "33689965433",
    "sender": "MyShop",
    "tag": "accountValidation",
    "type": "marketing",
    "unicodeEnabled": true,
    "webUrl": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
    "params": {
      "FNAME": "Joe",
      "LNAME": "Doe"
    },
    "templateId": 123,
    "content": null
  }'
```

`POST /transactionalSMS/sms`

Send a transactional SMS message to a single mobile number. The `sender`, `recipient`, and either `content` or `templateId` fields are required. The sender name is limited to 11 alphanumeric characters or 15 numeric characters, and the recipient must be a valid international phone number (6-15 digits, optional leading +). Tags can be a string or an array of up to 10 strings. The SMS type defaults to `transactional` but can be set to `marketing`; if the content includes a stop code, it is automatically treated as marketing. Returns the message ID, SMS count, credits used, and remaining credits.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
  "recipient": "33689965433",
  "sender": "MyShop",
  "tag": "accountValidation",
  "type": "marketing",
  "unicodeEnabled": true,
  "webUrl": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
  "params": {
    "FNAME": "Joe",
    "LNAME": "Doe"
  },
  "templateId": 123,
  "content": null
}
```

Numeric sender names (12-15 characters) must contain only digits.<br>|

These are the placeholder variables in the template that will be replaced with the corresponding values passed in the params object. Applicable only if `templateId` is used.|

## Get your SMS activity aggregated over a period of time

<a id="opIdgetTransacAggregatedSmsReport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/transactionalSMS/statistics/aggregatedReport \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /transactionalSMS/statistics/aggregatedReport`

Retrieve an aggregated report of your transactional SMS activity over a specified time period, including counts for requests, delivered, hard bounces, soft bounces, blocked, unsubscribed, replied, accepted, rejected, and skipped messages. Filter by date range using `startDate` and `endDate` (both required together, YYYY-MM-DD format) or by a number of past `days` (not compatible with date range). You can further narrow results by `tag`. If no date filter is provided, the report covers all available data and returns the auto-detected date range.

<h3 id="get-your-sms-activity-aggregated-over-a-period-of-time-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report<br>|
|endDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report<br>|
|days|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of days in the past including today (positive integer). **Not compatible with startDate and endDate**<br>|
|tag|query|string|false|Filter on a tag|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "accepted": 6,
  "blocked": 4,
  "delivered": 16,
  "hardBounces": 5,
  "range": "2015-05-22|2017-11-29",
  "rejected": 14,
  "replied": 8,
  "requests": 54,
  "skipped": 1,
  "softBounces": 26,
  "unsubscribed": 10
}
```

> 400 Response

{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "POST Method is not allowed on this path"
}

## Get all your SMS activity (unaggregated events)

<a id="opIdgetSmsEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/transactionalSMS/statistics/events \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /transactionalSMS/statistics/events`

Retrieve a paginated list of individual SMS event records (unaggregated), including event type, phone number, message ID, timestamp, tag, and reason or reply content where applicable. Results default to 50 per page (max 100) and are sorted in descending order unless overridden. Filter by date range (`startDate`/`endDate`), past `days` (not compatible with date range), specific `event` type (e.g. delivered, bounces, replies), `phoneNumber`, or `tags`. Bounce events include the failure reason, and reply events include the reply content.

<h3 id="get-all-your-sms-activity-unaggregated-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of documents per page|
|startDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report<br>|
|endDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report<br>|
|offset|query|integer(int64)|false|Index of the first document of the page|
|days|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of days in the past including today (positive integer). **Not compatible with 'startDate' and 'endDate'**<br>|
|phoneNumber|query|string|false|Filter the report for a specific phone number|
|event|query|string|false|Filter the report for specific events|
|tags|query|string|false|Filter the report for specific tags passed as a serialized urlencoded array|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|event|bounces|
|event|hardBounces|
|event|softBounces|
|event|delivered|
|event|sent|
|event|accepted|
|event|unsubscription|
|event|replies|
|event|blocked|
|event|rejected|
|event|skipped|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

## Get your SMS activity aggregated per day

<a id="opIdgetTransacSmsReport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.brevo.com/v3/transactionalSMS/statistics/reports \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /transactionalSMS/statistics/reports`

Retrieve a day-by-day breakdown of your transactional SMS activity, with each entry containing the date and counts for requests, delivered, hard bounces, soft bounces, blocked, unsubscribed, replied, accepted, rejected, and skipped messages. Filter by date range using `startDate` and `endDate` (both required together, YYYY-MM-DD format), by a number of past `days` (not compatible with date range), or by `tag`. Results are sorted in descending order by default unless overridden with the `sort` parameter.

<h3 id="get-your-sms-activity-aggregated-per-day-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report<br>|
|endDate|query|string|false|**Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report<br>|
|days|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of days in the past including today (positive integer). **Not compatible with 'startDate' and 'endDate'**<br>|
|tag|query|string|false|Filter on a tag|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "reports": [
    {
      "accepted": 2318,
      "blocked": 1026,
      "date": "2017-04-30",
      "delivered": 10103,

      "replied": 5091,

    },

    },

    "cashier": "Alice"
  },
  "eventTag": "Summer2026",
  "location": "Mall of America, Minneapolis"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amountSpent|number(float)|false|none|Amount spent during the visit or transaction. Useful for point-of-sale integrations and purchase tracking.|
|customData|object|false|none|Arbitrary key/value pairs merged into the scan event's properties, for use in automations and segmentation (e.g. register id, cashier, department). Reserved keys take precedence over the same keys supplied here: `passId` is always set by the endpoint, and `location`, `amountSpent` and `eventTag` are replaced by the matching top-level fields when those are sent.|
|eventTag|string|false|none|Free-form tag identifying the event or context of the scan (e.g. an event name a contact attended). Useful to segment or route automations.|
|location|string|false|none|Location where the scan occurred. Can be a store name, address, or any identifier relevant to your use case.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attachmentFile|string|false|none|Url of the attachment file. Only available if the campaign has an attachment.|
|abTesting|boolean|false|none|Status of A/B Test for the campaign. abTesting = false means it is disabled, & abTesting = true means it is enabled.|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the campaign|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the campaign|
|previewText|string|false|none|Preview text or preheader of the email campaign|
|scheduledAt|string|false|none|UTC date-time on which campaign is scheduled (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)|
|sendAtBestTime|boolean|false|none|It is true if you have chosen to send your campaign at best time, otherwise it is false|
|splitRule|integer|false|none|The size of your ab-test groups. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|status|string|true|none|Status of the campaign|
|subject|string|false|none|Subject of the campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `false`|
|subjectA|string|false|none|Subject A of the ab-test campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|subjectB|string|false|none|Subject B of the ab-test campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|type|string|true|none|Type of campaign|
|winnerCriteria|string|false|none|Criteria for the winning version. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|winnerDelay|integer|false|none|The duration of the test in hours at the end of which the winning version will be sent. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`|
|attachmentUrl|string|false|none|URL of the attachment file associated with the campaign. Empty string if no attachment is present.|
|createdAt|string|true|none|Creation UTC date-time of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)|
|emailExpirationDate|object|false|none|Expiration date configuration for the email campaign, if set. Contains the duration and unit of the email expiry.|
|footer|string|true|none|Footer of the campaign|
|header|string|true|none|Header of the campaign|
|htmlContent|string|true|none|HTML content of the campaign|
|inlineImageActivation|boolean|false|none|Status of inline image. inlineImageActivation = false means image can’t be embedded, & inlineImageActivation = true means image can be embedded, in the email.|
|mirrorActive|boolean|false|none|Status of mirror links in campaign. mirrorActive = false means mirror links are deactivated, & mirrorActive = true means mirror links are activated, in the campaign|
|modifiedAt|string|true|none|UTC date-time of last modification of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)|
|recurring|boolean|false|none|FOR TRIGGER ONLY ! Type of trigger campaign.recurring = false means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign only once, & recurring = true means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign several times|
|replyTo|string(email)|true|none|Email defined as the "Reply to" of the campaign|
|returnBounce|integer(int64)|false|none|Total number of non-delivered campaigns for a particular campaign id.|
|sender|object|true|none|none|
|sentDate|string|false|none|Sent UTC date-time of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ). Only available if 'status' of the campaign is 'sent'|
|shareLink|string|false|none|Link to share the campaign on social media. For trigger campaigns, this returns a descriptive message instead of a URL. For classic campaigns that have not been sent, this also returns a descriptive message.|
|tag|string|false|none|Tag of the campaign|
|tags|[string]|false|none|List of tags of the campaign|
|testSent|boolean|true|none|Retrieved the status of test email sending. (true=Test email has been sent  false=Test email has not been sent)|
|toField|string|false|none|Customisation of the "to" field of the campaign|
|utmCampaignValue|string|false|none|The utm_campaign value applied to the campaign's tracking links. Falls back to your account's global UTM settings when no custom value was set on the campaign, or the campaign name if neither is configured. Only returned when UTM tracking is enabled on the campaign.|
|utmContent|string|false|none|The utm_content value applied to the campaign's tracking links. Falls back to your account's global UTM settings when no custom value was set on the campaign. Only returned when UTM tracking is enabled on the campaign and a value is set at one of these levels.|
|utmID|integer(int64)|false|none|Legacy numeric utm_id value applied to the campaign's tracking links. Present only when UTM tracking is enabled on the campaign and the resolved utm_id is numeric (typically the campaign's ID). For customer-supplied non-numeric values (for example `promo_042`), read `utmId` (string) instead. Kept for backward compatibility.|
|utmId|string|false|none|The utm_id value applied to the campaign's tracking links, returned verbatim as a string. Falls back to your account's global UTM settings when no custom value was set on the campaign. Only returned when UTM tracking is enabled on the campaign and a value is set at one of these levels. Preferred field for new consumers — covers both numeric IDs and customer-supplied non-numeric strings.|
|utmMedium|string|false|none|The utm_medium value applied to the campaign's tracking links. Falls back to your account's global UTM settings when no custom value was set on the campaign, or the default `email` if neither is configured. Case is preserved verbatim. Only returned when UTM tracking is enabled on the campaign.|
|utmSource|string|false|none|The utm_source value applied to the campaign's tracking links. Falls back to your account's global UTM settings when no custom value was set on the campaign, or the account default (`brevo` or `sendinblue`) if neither is configured. Case is preserved verbatim. Only returned when UTM tracking is enabled on the campaign.|
|utmTerm|string|false|none|The utm_term value applied to the campaign's tracking links. Falls back to your account's global UTM settings when no custom value was set on the campaign. Only returned when UTM tracking is enabled on the campaign and a value is set at one of these levels.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|draft|
|status|sent|
|status|archive|
|status|queued|
|status|suspended|
|status|in_process|
|status|in_review|
|status|cancelling|
|status|cancelled|
|type|classic|
|type|trigger|

|id|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the template|
|isActive|boolean|true|none|Status of template (true=active, false=inactive)|

|name|string|true|none|Name of the template|
|replyTo|string(email)|true|none|Email defined as the "Reply to" for the template|
|sender|object|true|none|none|
|subject|string|true|none|Subject of the template|
|tag|string|true|none|Tag of the template|
|testSent|boolean|true|none|Status of test sending for the template (true=test email has been sent, false=test email has not been sent)|
|toField|string|true|none|Customisation of the "to" field for the template|
|customTemplateId|string|false|none|Custom template identifier, if one was assigned during template creation. Only present when the template has a custom ID.|

<h2 id="tocS_sendTransacSms">sendTransacSms</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasendtransacsms"></a>
<a id="schema_sendTransacSms"></a>
<a id="tocSsendtransacsms"></a>
<a id="tocssendtransacsms"></a>

```json
{
  "organisationPrefix": "MyCompany",
  "recipient": "33689965433",
  "sender": "MyShop",
  "tag": "accountValidation",
  "type": "marketing",
  "unicodeEnabled": true,
  "webUrl": "http://requestb.in/173lyyx1",
  "params": {
    "FNAME": "Joe",
    "LNAME": "Doe"
  },
  "templateId": 123,
  "content": null
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organisationPrefix|string|false|none|A recognizable prefix will ensure your audience knows who you are. Recommended by U.S. carriers. This will be added as your Brand Name before the message content. **Prefer verifying maximum length of 160 characters including this prefix in message content to avoid multiple sending of same sms.**|
|recipient|string|true|none|Mobile number to send SMS with the country code. Must contain between 6 and 15 digits, optionally prefixed with '+'.<br>|
|sender|string|true|none|Name of the sender. **The number of characters is limited to 11 for alphanumeric characters and 15 for numeric characters.** Alphanumeric sender names (up to 11 characters) must contain only letters and digits. Numeric sender names (12-15 characters) must contain only digits.<br>|
|tag|string \| [string]|false|none|Tag of the message. Can be a single string or an array of strings (maximum 10 tags). Each tag must be a non-empty string.<br>|
|type|string|false|none|Type of the SMS. Marketing SMS messages are those sent typically with marketing content. Transactional SMS messages are sent to individuals and are triggered in response to some action, such as a sign-up, purchase, etc.|
|unicodeEnabled|boolean|false|none|Format of the message. It indicates whether the content should be treated as unicode or not.<br>|
|webUrl|string(url)|false|none|Webhook to call for each event triggered by the message (delivered etc.)|
|params|object|false|none|Pass the set of attributes to customize the template. For example, {"FNAME":"Joe", "LNAME":"Doe"}. These are the placeholder variables in the template that will be replaced with the corresponding values passed in the params object. Applicable only if `templateId` is used.|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|Send SMS using a template ID.|
|templateId|integer|true|none|Template ID to send SMS with the template. When provided, overrides the content parameter. Mandatory if 'content' is not passed.|
|content|object|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|Send SMS using direct content.|
|content|string|true|none|Content of the message. If more than **160 characters** long, will be sent as multiple text messages. Mandatory if 'templateId' is not passed, ignored if 'templateId' is passed.<br>|
|templateId|object|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|transactional|
|type|marketing|
